entities.summary: Marcelo Patricio Nicola Virginio is an Argentine-Italian former professional basketball player and a current coach. A very versatile power forward, he was a regular member of the Argentine national basketball team, and competed many years in the EuroLeague. He was most recently the head coach for Scafati Basket of the Lega Basket Serie A (LBA).
